risk: Budget loaded in IFMIS differs from the appropriation law
control_activity: Budget load totals reconciled to the appropriation law by line and approved by a second officer before activation
evidence: Signed reconciliation of budget load to law
test_procedure: Re-perform the reconciliation for a sample of entities

control_activity: System prevents cumulative releases from exceeding the appropriation per line
test_procedure: Attempt a release above appropriation in test environment

risk: Over- or under-spending not detected in time
control_activity: Monthly review of budget execution report (RPT-03) with sign-off and actions
Funds-availability check blocks commitments above available budget (hard stop)
test_procedure: Attempt a commitment above available budget

control_activity: Reallocations through system workflow within legal limits; two-level approval and reason code
test_procedure: Trace sample reallocations to approvals and legal limits

risk: Transactions coded to invalid segment combinations
control_activity: Account combination validation rules CR-01 to CR-09 enforced at entry

risk: Payment for goods not ordered or not received
control_activity: Three-way match of PO; GRN and invoice within tolerance; mismatch blocks payment
test_procedure: Select invoices and verify PO and GRN agreement

control_activity: Payment approval limits by amount; preparer cannot approve own voucher
test_procedure: Review user roles for conflicts; test approval limits

risk: Payments diverted to wrong bank accounts
control_activity: Payee bank details taken only from supplier master; changes need independent verification and approval
test_procedure: Trace sample of bank-detail changes to verification evidence

risk: Errors or irregular items in bank accounts go undetected
control_activity: Monthly bank reconciliation for every account; prepared and approved by different officers by working day 10
test_procedure: Re-perform a reconciliation; check timeliness for all accounts

risk: Receipts not linked to bills or misclassified
control_activity: System-generated unique payment reference on every bill; revenue code fixed at billing
test_procedure: Check uniqueness of references for a period

risk: Unidentified receipts left unresolved or misused
control_activity: Suspense items require reason code; ageing report reviewed weekly; cleared within 30 days
evidence: Suspense ageing report with review notes
test_procedure: Inspect ageing; trace old items to clearance
